items.label: Minimalist Design
items.value: Designed with simplicity in mind, this farmhouse console table features a classic brown finish that infuses cozy vibe into any home. The deep wood grain and rounded corners add softness and enhance visual flow

items.label: 2-Tier Display
items.value: Featuring a two-tier design, this entryway console table offers a spacious tabletop measuring L 62.99" and W 13.77". You can harmonize your home decor with various delicate decorations, thereby elevating the aesthetic of living space

items.label: Versatile Applications
items.value: This narrow sofa table not only serves as a welcoming table at the entrance, adding a touch of vibrancy to hallways, but also becomes a big highlight when placed behind a sofa, showcasing your unique home decor taste

items.label: High-Quality Material
items.value: Crafted from E1 MDF, this 2-tier sofa table boasts a smooth surface and measures 2.95 inches in thickness. Its rectangular design ensures exceptional stability, while the bottom shelf offers robust support, capable of holding up to 300lb

items.label: Simple Assembly
items.value: This foyer accent table is designed with a simple structure, making it easy to install without any complications. Furthermore, we offer clear assembly guidelines and provide dedicated after-sales customer service to assist you with any questions
